baseline_limit: First repository import, not a verified licensed vendor release

app/Http/Controllers/Admin/VendorControl.purpose: Authoritative route decisions and generic application/status event integration
app/Http/Controllers/Admin/VendorControl.upstream_behavior: Same admin success redirect and mail preference checks; intentional POST/idempotency safety correction
app/Http/Controllers/Admin/VendorControl.reason_in_core: Existing admin routes own approval; no optional-module hook can safely replace their business transaction
app/Http/Controllers/Admin/VendorControl.upgrade: Review status and updateVendorApplication methods against new vendor release; reapply only generic decision hooks

app/Services/VendorApplicationDecisionSe.purpose: Atomic vendor/store decisions, subscription activation on approval, repeat suppression, normal model events
app/Services/VendorApplicationDecisionSe.upstream_behavior: Preserves host ownership of application state; corrects inconsistent denial/subscription effects
app/Services/VendorApplicationDecisionSe.reason_in_core: Host approval must work independently of every optional channel
app/Services/VendorApplicationDecisionSe.upgrade: Reconcile vendor/store/subscription columns and new host observers before retaining service

app/Events/VendorApplicationStatusChange.upstream_behavior: Adds notification metadata without changing API serialization
app/Events/VendorApplicationStatusChange.reason_in_core: Host can emit the event without any registered listener
app/Events/VendorApplicationStatusChange.upgrade: Prefer equivalent upstream domain event if supplied

routes/admin.php.purpose: POST-only application decisions with legacy GET redirect
routes/admin.php.upstream_behavior: Intentional security correction: GET no longer changes application state
routes/admin.php.reason_in_core: Must protect host decisions with or without optional modules
routes/admin.php.upgrade: Preserve route name/path and POST/CSRF; verify vendor route changes

resources/views/admin-views/vendor/pendi.purpose: CSRF-protected POST approval and denial controls; no channel badge query
resources/views/admin-views/vendor/pendi.upstream_behavior: Same admin decisions and confirmation prompts
resources/views/admin-views/vendor/pendi.reason_in_core: Existing host form must match the safe route
resources/views/admin-views/vendor/pendi.upgrade: Reapply only POST form/CSRF changes to new vendor template

resources/views/admin-views/vendor/deny_.reason_in_core: Existing host form must match the safe route

resources/views/admin-views/vendor/view/.purpose: CSRF-protected POST approval and denial controls
resources/views/admin-views/vendor/view/.reason_in_core: Existing host form must match the safe route

resources/lang/en/messages.php.purpose: Generic decision confirmation and success labels
resources/lang/en/messages.php.reason_in_core: Host templates need labels while module is absent
